newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Australia urged to integrate with Asia - Salomon.
newsitem.headline: Australia urged to integrate with Asia - Salomon.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Wednesday Australia must seize the opportunity to integrate its economy with Asia to benefit from the rapid economic growth of its neighbours.
"There should be no doubt that Australia's long-term political and economic prosperity is linked to Asia's future," Salomon Brothers Asia Pacific chairman Trevor Rowe said in a statement.

"The issue is really whether Australia can make itself necessary to Asia or be left out of the growth story," he said. "Australia must, therefore, seize the opportunity to integrate its economy with Asia -- and become integral to Asia."
Rowe said Asian investment accounted for 20 percent of office, retail, industrial and hotel commercial property purchases in Australia for the period of January 1990 through October 1996.

In 1994, 66 percent of Australia's exports went to Asian countries including Japan and 30 Asian companies listed on the Asutralian stock exchange with a market capitalisation of approximately A$1.3 billion, he said.
He said Australia can market its expertise in environmental management to neighbouring developing economies, its tourism industry to Asians.
